At just 43 years old Emma Victoria Johnson was diagnosed with Stage 4 breast cancer and told she had only 18 months to live Refusing conventional chemotherapy she chose an alternative path that changed everything
In this powerful Patriots With Grit interview Emma shares how she sought treatment at Oasis of Hope Hospital in Mexico the lifestyle changes she made the therapies she underwent and why she believes they saved her life
Whether you agree or disagree this is a remarkable story of courage hope and personal conviction that is inspiring conversations around the world

programme.title: How The Giants Returned After The Flood
programme.desc:
In this PATREON PREMIUM episode I sit down with Bennett Tanton host of Broadcasting Seeds and author of The Second Incursion Fallen Beings Giants What Walks Among Us Still to dig into one of the strangest and most ignored threads in Scripture the Nephilim post-flood giants Babel the divine council ancient gods forbidden knowledge and the supernatural rebellion behind history
Most Christians know about Goliath Far fewer ask why giants appear after the flood if the flood wiped out the corruption of Genesis 6 That question opens the door to a much larger biblical mystery involving the Watchers territorial powers ancient mythologies cryptids hybrid beings Psalm 82 Deuteronomy 32 and the war most churches are not preparing people to fight
This is not just a conversation about ancient giants It is about the supernatural worldview of the Bible the spiritual war behind the nations and the terrifying question at the heart of Bennett’s work
Did the incursion really end
